build_mhr_head_model: build an MHRHead instance with input_dim and mhr_model_path to predict 3D body mesh from pose tokens
run_mhr_forward: run mhr_forward with global_trans, global_rot, body_pose_params, and shape_params to get skinned vertices
create_zero_pose_init: create a zero-pose initialization tensor using get_zero_pose_init for pose token warm starting
replace_hands_in_pose: replace hand pose parameters in full_pose_params using replace_hands_in_pose with PCA 6D hand predictions
forward_mhr_head: forward a batch of pose tokens through MHRHead to get 3D keypoints, vertices, and joint coordinates
